mapper.select: SELECT ap.admin_permission_idx, ap.user_idx, ap.permission_code, pp.display_name, ap.is_active, gb.nickname AS granted_by_nickname, rb.nickname AS requested_by_nickname, ab.nickname AS approved_by_nickname, ap.description, ap.granted_at, ap.revoked_at, ap.created_at, ap.updated_at FROM ADMIN_PERMISSION ap JOIN ADMIN_PERMISSION_POLICY pp ON ap.permission_code = pp.permission_code LEFT JOIN USERS gb ON ap.granted_by_user_idx = gb.user_idx LEFT JOIN USERS rb ON ap.granted_request_by_user_idx = rb.user_idx LEFT JOIN USERS ab ON ap.granted_approval_by_user_idx = ab.user_idx WHERE ap.user_idx = #{userIdx} ORDER BY ap.updated_at DESC

mapper.select: SELECT p.admin_permission_group_policy_idx, p.group_code, p.display_name, p.description, p.is_active, p.priority, p.created_at, COUNT(i.admin_permission_group_item_idx) AS item_count FROM ADMIN_PERMISSION_GROUP_POLICY p LEFT JOIN ADMIN_PERMISSION_GROUP_ITEM i ON p.group_code = i.group_code AND i.is_active = 1 GROUP BY p.admin_permission_group_policy_idx, p.group_code, p.display_name, p.description, p.is_active, p.priority, p.created_at ORDER BY p.priority DESC, p.created_at DESC

SELECT i.admin_permission_group_item_idx, i.group_code, i.permission_code, pp.display_name, i.is_active FROM ADMIN_PERMISSION_GROUP_ITEM i JOIN ADMIN_PERMISSION_POLICY pp ON i.permission_code = pp.permission_code WHERE i.group_code = #{groupCode} AND i.is_active = 1 ORDER BY pp.priority DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_PERMISSION_GROUP_POLICY (group_code, display_name, description, is_active, created_by_user_idx, updated_by_user_idx, priority) VALUES (#{groupCode}, #{displayName}, #{description}, 1, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy}, 1)

INSERT INTO ADMIN_PERMISSION_GROUP_ITEM (group_code, permission_code, is_active, created_by_user_idx, updated_by_user_idx, priority) VALUES (#{groupCode}, #{permissionCode}, 1, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_active = 1, updated_by_user_idx = #{createdBy}, updated_at = NOW()

mapper.select: SELECT ap.admin_permission_idx, ap.user_idx, u.nickname AS user_nickname, ap.permission_code, pp.display_name AS permission_display_name, r.nickname AS requested_by_nickname, ap.description, ap.created_at FROM ADMIN_PERMISSION ap JOIN USERS u ON ap.user_idx = u.user_idx JOIN ADMIN_PERMISSION_POLICY pp ON ap.permission_code = pp.permission_code LEFT JOIN USERS r ON ap.granted_request_by_user_idx = r.user_idx WHERE ap.is_active = 0 AND ap.granted_request_by_user_idx IS NOT NULL AND ap.granted_approval_by_user_idx IS NULL AND ap.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY ap.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ADMIN_PERMISSION WHERE is_active = 0 AND granted_request_by_user_idx IS NOT NULL AND granted_approval_by_user_idx IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_PERMISSION (user_idx, permission_code, is_active, granted_request_by_user_idx, description, created_by_user_idx, updated_by_user_idx, priority) VALUES (#{userIdx}, #{permissionCode}, 0, #{requestedBy}, #{description}, #{requestedBy}, #{requestedBy}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE granted_request_by_user_idx = IF(is_active = 0, #{requestedBy}, granted_request_by_user_idx), granted_approval_by_user_idx = IF(is_active = 0, NULL, granted_approval_by_user_idx), revoked_at = IF(is_active = 0, NULL, revoked_at), description = IF(is_active = 0, #{description}, description), updated_by_user_idx = #{requestedBy}, updated_at = NOW()
